tool_description: AutoMorph_segmentation is a Docker-based tool for automatic segmentation of retinal structures, including vessels, arteries vs. veins, and optic disc & cup, from fundus images.

input.description: Path to the input folder containing retinal fundus images (e.g., JPG or PNG).

output.description: Path to the output folder where segmentation results will be saved.

segmentation_flags.description: Optional flags to specify which segmentations to perform. If none are specified, the tool will skip execution. If any are omitted, only the selected segmentations will be performed.

segmentation_outputs.description: Paths to the output segmentation mask images (e.g., vessel masks, artery/vein overlays, disc/cup masks).

segmentation_options.--run-vessel: Segment all vessels in the image
segmentation_options.--run-artery-vein: Perform artery/vein classification on segmented vessels
segmentation_options.--run-disc-cup: Segment the optic disc and cup regions
